## Research interests

Statistical prediction and model evaluation; probability calibration; distribution shift and model adaptation; extreme value theory and tail-risk modeling; Monte Carlo methods; credit risk; statistical and quantitative risk modeling.

## Research and manuscripts

- **Selection Regret in Credit-Risk Model Updating Under Distribution Shift: The Role of Recent Labeled Information** — Working manuscript, 2026. Cross-validation-based policy selection, fitted-candidate oracle comparisons, and Brier-risk selection regret, evaluated through simulation and historical Fannie Mae data.



- **Stable Fire-Loss Quantiles and Far-Tail Expected Shortfall Gaps** — Independent research manuscript, unpublished, 2026. Analysis of NFIRS fire-loss records using tail-risk estimation and extensive robustness checks.
- **Predictive stability and adaptation under distribution shift** — With Shudeshna Nandy. Unpublished research manuscript, 2026. Evaluation of calibration, discrimination, probability accuracy, and updating methods using a loan-default benchmark and Monte Carlo experiments.
- **Application of extreme value theory to fire insurance** — Undergraduate thesis, KNUST, 2020. Severe fire-insurance losses and tail-risk behavior.

[Research descriptions and available code →](research.qmd)
